description: This file is a script written for Node.js, mainly used to identify and report unresolved merge conflict markers within tracked files in a Git repository. It provides functions to list files, check for conflict markers, and output violations.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data by looking for null bytes.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Finds lines in content that are conflict markers from Git merge conflicts.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Lists all tracked files in the current Git repository.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks multiple files for conflict markers, returning violations with file paths and line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing the conflict markers check across tracked files, reporting unresolved conflicts.
